findings.text: Public formatted emitter accepts facility and level with message format and arguments and delegates to central print emission without dictionary data, returning emission outcome.

Per opener devkmsg state combines monotonic cursor known as seq with throttling state known as rs plus exclusion object known as lock plus reusable message buffers known as pbufs, giving each opener independent position and rate history.

Syslog authorization treats global restriction flag as forcing restriction for every action while otherwise leaving action SYSLOG_ACTION_READ_ALL and also action SYSLOG_ACTION_SIZE_BUFFER open to all callers, exempts source SYSLOG_FROM_PROC from repeated privilege evaluation except when action is SYSLOG_ACTION_OPEN, demands privilege CAP_SYSLOG for restricted actions with denial otherwise, and always defers finally to security hook outcome.

User injection interprets optional leading numeric tag as combined facility with level and enforces fallback to user facility known as LOG_USER when tag omits facility, emits through central path with default level otherwise, enforces upper bound PRINTKRB_RECORD_MAX with invalid error, honors global disable mask DEVKMSG_LOG_MASK_OFF by reporting success without action, and otherwise subjects configurations lacking enable mask DEVKMSG_LOG_MASK_ON to per opener rate control before copying and emitting.

Devkmsg read serializes check with wait plus advance using per opener mutex acquired interruptibly, advances cursor past delivered record and resynchronizes with pipe error known as EPIPE when history vanished, blocks interruptibly on shared wait queue when no record is ready unless flag O_NONBLOCK requests immediate retry error known as EAGAIN, and validates destination capacity with invalid error known as EINVAL before copying out with fault error known as EFAULT on failure.

Kernel message device exposes file operations binding release handler known as devkmsg_release plus poll handler known as devkmsg_poll plus seek handler known as devkmsg_llseek plus write handler known as devkmsg_write plus read handler known as devkmsg_read plus open handler known as devkmsg_open, providing unified user access for emitting with polling plus repositioning plus lifecycle management.

Repositioning requires zero offset with pipe error known as ESPIPE otherwise, supports past newest origin known as SEEK_END plus oldest valid origin known as SEEK_SET plus post clear origin known as SEEK_DATA, reports invalid error known as EINVAL for unknown origin, and leaves global state unchanged while only moving per opener cursor.

Readiness reporting registers shared wait queue, yields no events when no record is valid at cursor, signals readable pair EPOLLIN with EPOLLRDNORM when expected sequence is present, and augments with error pair EPOLLERR with EPOLLPRI when valid record differs from cursor indicating loss.

Opener lifecycle allocates per opener context with default rate control plus release message flag known as RATELIMIT_MSG_ON_RELEASE plus initialized mutex plus cursor at oldest valid, but denies all opens when global disable mask known as DEVKMSG_LOG_MASK_OFF is set, requires authorization for action SYSLOG_ACTION_READ_ALL with source SYSLOG_FROM_READER for modes other than mode O_WRONLY while write only skips that check, and on release exits rate state plus destroys mutex plus frees context.
Crash introspection setup publishes global symbols and structural size with offset metadata enabling external tools to parse evolving ring layouts across versions.

Published layout facts include symbols known as prb with printk_rb_static plus clear marker known as clear_seq, sizes with offsets for containers known as printk_ringbuffer with prb_desc_ring plus descriptors known as prb_desc with positions known as prb_data_blk_lpos plus info known as printk_info with device detail known as dev_printk_info plus data ring known as prb_data_ring plus atomic type known as atomic_long_t plus sequence type known as latched_seq, with lengths for subsystem with device strings.

Offset facts cover descriptor ring count with arrays plus head with tail, descriptor state with text position begin with next, data ring size with data plus head with tail, info sequence with timestamp plus text length plus caller plus device linkage, device subsystem with device name, and latched value with atomic counter.

Pending variable known as new_log_buf_len retains only requests exceeding current length, clamps oversize requests to maximum known as LOG_BUF_LEN_MAX with diagnostic, normalizes nonzero requests upward to power of two, and boot parameter parsing rejects missing strings with invalid error while otherwise parsing size and delegating to update.

Sizing facts define count macro known as _DESCS_COUNT as power of two of count bits, position macro known as BLK0_LPOS as negated data size of size bits, state macro known as DESC0_SV as reusable with initial identifier, and per CPU allowance known as __LOG_CPU_MAX_BUF_LEN as power of two of configured shift.

Iteration helpers start from supplied sequence and advance to successor of each successfully read record or info entry, with info variant additionally yielding line count, terminating when validity check fails.

Boot options provide unconditional activation of level ignoring flag known as ignore_loglevel with informational diagnostic, and pacing control known as boot_delay deriving loops variable known as loops_per_msec from preset known as preset_lpj or guess scaled by frequency known as HZ while parsing requested delay and clearing excessive values above ten seconds with debug summary.
Ring services expose initialization establishing empty descriptor with text rings and defined identifiers, plus accessor reporting reserved text capacity of a reservation.

Migration helper reports consumed text space after finalizing a reservation while duplicating text plus metadata including timing with identity plus device detail, returning zero when reservation fails, and percpu readiness is marked by a one way flag set during late setup.

Log buffer setup migrates from static to dynamic storage by switching active pointer under interrupt exclusion after bulk copying early records and then copying any concurrently arrived records with dropped accounting, but returns immediately if already switched, marks percpu readiness on late invocation, extends pending size from CPU contribution when no explicit size exists, validates descriptor count and allocation success with diagnostics plus cleanup plus usage statistics on failure, and finally reports data plus metadata sizes with early free proportion.

Synchronization relies on shared queue known as log_wait with full barrier pairing between sleeper preparation and wakeup for blocking reads, interrupt exclusion around active pointer switch with length updates during buffer migration, and mutex known as syslog_lock guarding cursor known as syslog_seq plus partial offset known as syslog_partial plus time snapshot known as syslog_time plus clear marker known as clear_seq while being released across waits and user copies.

Loss and contention hazards include vanished history reported as pipe error with cursor resynchronization plus poll error indications, partial reads preserving offsets with time consistency, oversized or undersized user buffers rejected as invalid, user copy faults and allocation failures propagated, interrupt races during migration handled by second copy with dropped reporting, and fitting search using best effort accounting that may skip concurrently arriving records.

System control entry first enforces syslog permission and then demultiplexes console actions known as SYSLOG_ACTION_CONSOLE_OFF with SYSLOG_ACTION_CONSOLE_ON plus SYSLOG_ACTION_CONSOLE_LEVEL involving save plus restore plus clamping and implicit reenable, read variants known as SYSLOG_ACTION_READ with SYSLOG_ACTION_READ_ALL plus SYSLOG_ACTION_READ_CLEAR involving buffer validation plus fitting selection plus optional clear advancement, global clear known as SYSLOG_ACTION_CLEAR to next sequence, and actions known as SYSLOG_ACTION_OPEN with SYSLOG_ACTION_CLOSE as no operation success.

Read paths advance global clear marker to past newest on explicit clear, select earliest fitting start from clear marker up to unlimited when dumping all with optional advancement to stopping point, and for sequential consumption emit fitting or partial content with accumulation until buffer exhaustion or fault after snapshotting time at line start plus resynchronizing on vanished records plus waiting for cursor availability with mutex release plus reacquire and sequence revalidation.

Console verbosity control maintains saved level known as saved_console_loglevel defaulting to default known as LOGLEVEL_DEFAULT, preserves current level known as console_loglevel on first suppression and forces minimum known as minimum_console_loglevel, restores preserved level on reenable and resets saved marker, and on explicit level assignment clamps to minimum while clearing saved marker to implicitly reenable.

Limit facts include maximum user record known as PRINTKRB_RECORD_MAX plus maximum formatted message known as PRINTK_MESSAGE_MAX plus density parameter known as PRB_AVGBITS plus base size known as __LOG_BUF_LEN plus alignment known as LOG_ALIGN plus ceiling known as LOG_BUF_LEN_MAX as allocation and validation bounds.

CPU driven growth requests base plus per extra allowance but skips entirely on single processor configurations and when extra contribution does not exceed half of base size, with an alternate empty implementation providing no operation where the feature is unavailable.

Ring initialization seeds edge sequences to negative count with zero and zeroes failure counter plus marks final descriptor as reusable with failed positions, establishes size with data pointer plus head with tail at initial block position and count with array linkages plus head with tail at initial identifier plus zeroed finalization marker, after zeroing descriptor with info arrays.

Fitting search ignores concurrently arriving newest records as best effort to avoid retry loops, discards oldest until total fits or limit reached, after totaling printable sizes dependent on syslog with time formatting up to limit and clamping limit to actually scanned reach.
